about.title: Who is Samuel?
about.p1: II am a Fullstack Developer driven by creating intuitive interfaces, robust architectures, and end-to-end digital experiences. Pursuing a degree in Software Engineering (2029), I combine a passion for building modern, scalable web ecosystems with a solid foundation in Software Quality Assurance (QA) and Technical Support.
about.p2_1: I work across the full development
about.p2_2: combining backend technical rigor with frontend visual refinement and usability, always focused on delivering clean, efficient, and high-performance solutions.

about.trajectory_text: My journey began in Software Quality (QA), developing a critical eye for bugs and test automation (BDD/Robot). Today, I apply this "test-first" mindset in Fullstack development.
about.future_text: As a Software Engineer, my goal is to architect scalable applications and mentor the next generation, always seeking the balance between performant code and world-class UI/UX.
about.magic_phrase: "Good programmers write code that humans can understand"

footer.quote: "Transforming coffee and complex ideas into scalable web solutions."
